name: TT's Chicken Pot Pie in a Bowl
author: Ty Phelps
steps: Dice the onion and celery. In a pot, melt the butter and sauté the diced onion until it becomes fragrant.
Add the bone broth, diced celery and the frozen peas and carrots to the pot, and cook until they're no longer frozen.
While the vegetables are cooking, shred the rotisserie chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Once the veggies are ready, add the shredded chicken to the pot over medium-high heat.
Pour in the can of organic cream of chicken soup and stir everything together until well-blended.
Season with ground pepper to taste.
Once everything is combined and heated through, serve and enjoy!
